text:
## Compensation Framework  
**Financial Compensation Guidelines:**  
| Scenario | Compensation Range | Basis |
|----------|-------------------|-------|
| Service delay (1–2 days) | £0–£50 | Inconvenience |
| Service delay (3–5 days) | £50–£100 | Operational disruption |
| Service failure (>5 days) | £100–£300 | Significant impact |
| Financial loss (error) | Full loss + 8% interest | Actual loss + interest |
| Serious distress | £250–£500+ | Emotional impact |  
**Limits (aligned with Escalation Matrix above):**
- <£500: Complaints Manager approval
- £500–£2,000: Director approval
- >£2,000: CEO approval
- >£5,000: Board notification + CEO approval

raw_entities.name: Compensation Framework
raw_entities.description: A policy establishing financial compensation guidelines for customers affected by service delays, service failures, financial errors, and serious distress. The framework defines compensation ranges based on severity and duration of impact, with approval thresholds tied to compensation amount.
context: Financial loss (error) | Full loss + 8% interest | Actual loss + interest

raw_entities.name: Service Delay Compensation for One to Two Days
raw_entities.description: Requires compensation of £0–£50 for service delays lasting 1–2 days, based on inconvenience caused to the customer.

raw_entities.name: Service Delay Compensation for Three to Five Days
raw_entities.description: Requires compensation of £50–£100 for service delays lasting 3–5 days, reflecting operational disruption to the customer.

raw_entities.name: Service Failure Compensation for More Than Five Days
raw_entities.description: Requires compensation of £100–£300 for service failures exceeding 5 days, reflecting significant impact on the customer.

raw_entities.name: Financial Loss Compensation with Interest
raw_entities.description: Requires compensation equal to the full financial loss incurred by the customer plus 8% interest, covering errors that result in actual monetary loss.
context: Financial loss (error) | Full loss + 8% interest | Actual loss + interest

raw_entities.name: Serious Distress Compensation
raw_entities.description: Requires compensation of £250–£500 or more for cases involving serious distress, recognizing emotional impact on the customer.

raw_entities.name: Complaints Manager Approval for Compensation Under £500
raw_entities.description: Requires Complaints Manager approval for compensation awards below £500.

raw_entities.name: Director Approval for Compensation Between £500 and £2,000
raw_entities.description: Requires Director approval for compensation awards between £500 and £2,000.

raw_entities.name: CEO Approval for Compensation Over £2,000
raw_entities.description: Requires CEO approval for compensation awards exceeding £2,000.

raw_entities.name: Board Notification and CEO Approval for Compensation Over £5,000
raw_entities.description: Requires both Board notification and CEO approval for compensation awards exceeding £5,000.

raw_entities.name: Complaints Manager
raw_entities.description: Role responsible for approving compensation awards below £500 under the Compensation Framework.

raw_entities.name: Director
raw_entities.description: Role responsible for approving compensation awards between £500 and £2,000 under the Compensation Framework.

raw_entities.name: Chief Executive Officer
raw_entities.description: Role responsible for approving compensation awards exceeding £2,000 and for Board notification of awards exceeding £5,000 under the Compensation Framework.

raw_entities.name: Board
raw_entities.description: Role responsible for receiving notification of compensation awards exceeding £5,000 under the Compensation Framework.
